policy: Replace empty, NaN, and +/-Inf only with the median fitted on CIC source-train rows; 0.0 only if that source column has no finite training values.
split_rule: SHA-256 of canonical raw 53-feature strings; first 8 digest bytes interpreted big-endian modulo 100; train buckets 0-59, calibration 60-79, source_test 80-99
